name: Minimal text sequence
what: Clean white type on a soft, slowly drifting dark ground: a word zooms out from huge, a second word types in beside it and the pair slides away, a phrase follows word by word, and a big closing line wipes in with a soft edge on a flat dark ground.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f21 (00:00:00:00-00:00:00:21) the opening word zooms out from huge to size (very fast, then slow); f22-f40 (00:00:00:22-00:00:01:10) the second word types in with wide tracking that closes up while the pair slides left; f46-f64 (00:00:01:16-00:00:02:04) the pair slides out through a soft left edge; f59-f95 (00:00:01:29-00:00:03:05) the phrase's words slide in from the right one by one and settle; f111 (00:00:03:21) a cut to the closing text, wiped in from the left to f121 while it shrinks to size and the ground turns flat dark; then it holds

tracks.name: opening zoom
tracks.what: the opening word starts huge and zooms out to its size

tracks.name: slide left
tracks.what: the word slides from the centre to its place on the left

tracks.name: typing
tracks.what: the second word types in letter by letter, blurred, with wide tracking that closes up

tracks.name: pair exits
tracks.what: both words slide left and out through a soft edge

tracks.name: phrase words
tracks.what: each word of the phrase slides in from the right while fading up

tracks.name: closing wipe
tracks.what: a cut to the closing text, wiped in from the left while it shrinks to size

tracks.name: ground
tracks.what: blurred patches drift all the time; the ground turns flat dark under the closing text
